name: Hellfire Bellows reduces and fully resets its cooldown on server and client per Demonfire consumed (#13736)
contract: Hellfire Bellows 520292 (Knight of Xoroth, base cooldown 15000 ms) reads 'Cooldown is reduced by $/1000;704195s3 sec for each Demonfire consumed' (704195 effect 2 is -3000 ms, so 2 Demonfire leave 9000 ms and 5 or 6 Demonfire fully reset the 15000 ms cooldown). Previously, 520292 and its triggered behind-cone child 520857 shared Category 14 with 520857 carrying a 15000 ms CategoryRecoveryTime on the client while 520292 carried 0 RecoveryTime, and Player::ModifySpellCooldown never erased the cooldown or sent SMSG_CLEAR_COOLDOWN when a reduction reached or exceeded the remaining time. Now both spells clear Category 14 and stream their server recovery values to the client, and Player::ModifySpellCooldown calls RemoveSpellCooldown(spellId, true) when a reduction zeros the cooldown. A level-60 knight casts 520292 at 2 Demonfire (leaving ~9 s cooldown), then resets cooldown and casts at 5 Demonfire (asserting 0 ms server cooldown, an SMSG_CLEAR_COOLDOWN packet, and client_cooldown_ready == 1), then waits only the 1.6 s GCD and immediately recasts at 6 Demonfire without any client cooldown block.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle

CONTRACT: 5 Demonfire reset server cooldown to 0
CONTRACT: server sends SMSG_CLEAR_COOLDOWN for 5-stack reset
CONTRACT: client shows Hellfire Bellows ready immediately after 5-stack reset
Wait only the 1.6 s GCD inside the 15 s base cooldown
Immediately recast Hellfire Bellows with 6 Demonfire
CONTRACT: client never blocked the reset recast
